gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes naming the contract delivery method under which a project's work is executed. These codes are used for the value of the type property of the diggs:Contract object. Options drawn from the state-of-the-practice survey Han et al. (2025) reproduces (RI-DIGGS Technical Report Table 3-1, Figure 3-34).
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Contract Type Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The same entity (or a single joint venture) holds the contract for both design and construction. DB in the state-of-the-practice survey (Han et al. 2025) - the most common delivery method reported for rigid inclusion projects.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Design-build

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Design and construction are contracted separately and sequentially - the owner's design is completed and bid before a construction contractor is selected. DBB in the state-of-the-practice survey (Han et al. 2025).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Design-bid-build
